welcome.label: Welcome · the Downhill Derby

parts.label: 🔎 The case question
parts.title: Which ramp needs the most hay?
parts.body: Every car must stop safely in the hay bales at the finish line.

welcome.script:
(Hold your hands up high, then swoop them down like a car racing downhill.) Whoosh!

[ON SCREEN: A derby car]
This is a real derby car. It has no motor at all. So what makes it go?

[ON SCREEN: The race program]
Palmetto Beach is having a Downhill Derby, with three start ramps: Low, Middle and High.

[ON SCREEN: The case question]
Sam has to plan the hay bales at the finish line. Press Listen on Sam’s walkie-talkie, right below me.

warmup.label: Warm-Up · the flour crater test (Clue 1)

parts.label: 🥣 Try it with me
parts.title: A marble and a pan of flour

warmup.script:
(Show a pan of flour and a marble.) Watch this. I’ll drop the marble gently. (Drop it.) Now I’ll throw it down fast. (Throw it.)

[ON SCREEN: Try it with me]
Which crater is bigger? Same marble, same flour. What changed?

[ON SCREEN: Real craters]
The Moon has craters, too. Space rocks hit it very fast. Now flick the marble on your screen. Press Listen.

part1.label: Part 1 · scrub the replay (Clue 2)

parts.label: 🎞️ The replay
parts.title: Where is the energy?
parts.body: Step through 4 frames. Tap every place the energy is.

part1.script:
(Roll a pencil or a marble across your desk.) Does it have energy before it hits anything?

[ON SCREEN: The replay]
Step through the replay one frame at a time. At each frame, tap every place the energy is right now. Press Listen.

part2.label: Part 2 · pinball power (Clue 3)

parts.label: 🎳 Big and slow
parts.title: Bowling ball vs. baseball
parts.body: A 16-pound bowling ball rolled gently, or a 5-ounce baseball thrown fast. Which one knocks the blocks over?

part2.script:
(Pull your arm back a little, then all the way, like a slingshot.) Which pull sends it farther?

[ON SCREEN: Pinball power]
Pull the plunger, predict which light the ball will reach, then let go. Try all three pulls.

[ON SCREEN: Big and slow]
Then Round 2. Thumbs up for the bowling ball, thumbs down for the baseball. Press Listen.

explore.label: Part 4 · build Dune Hill (Clue 4)

parts.label: 🏁 Build Dune Hill
parts.title: Draw, play, measure
rows: Draw a track from a flag

explore.script:
(Prop a book on a stack of books like a ramp.) The higher the ramp, the faster the ride.

[ON SCREEN: A real derby hill]
This is a real derby hill. Now you get to draw your own.

[ON SCREEN: Build Dune Hill]
Draw a track from Low, Middle and High. Press Play, measure how far the hay bale slides, and build your bar chart. Press Listen.

assignment.label: Assignment · crack the case

parts.label: 🔓 Crack the case
parts.title: Which ramp needs the most hay?
parts.body: Pick the plan that fits all four clues.

assignment.script:
[ON SCREEN: Crack the case]
You have four clues. Crack the case at the top of this tab.

[ON SCREEN: Your case report]
Then write your case report: two short answers, your speed table for Part C, and your CER. Use the numbers from your bar chart! Press Listen.

evidence.label: Use your evidence · CER

parts.label: 💬 The claim
parts.title: A classmate says…
parts.body: “All moving objects have the same energy. Speed doesn’t really matter.”

parts.label: 🧩 The planner
parts.title: Claim · Evidence · Reasoning
rows: Tap I agree or I disagree.

evidence.script:
[ON SCREEN: The claim]
A classmate says speed doesn’t matter. Hmm. Think about your two craters. Think about the baseball and the bowling ball.

There’s no wrong side, as long as you prove it.

[ON SCREEN: The planner]
Tap your side and two facts, then explain how they prove your claim. Try starting with “This shows that…” Press Listen.

closing.label: Case closed

parts.label: 🏁 Your specimen
parts.title: Derby checkered flag
parts.body: Finish the checklist to stamp CASE CLOSED.

parts.label: ➡ Next time
parts.title: A fair test at Dune Hill
parts.body: One change at a time, and lots of tries.

closing.script:
Case closed! The High ramp gets the most hay, because faster cars carry more energy.

[ON SCREEN: Your specimen]
Finish your checklist, and your checkered flag goes into your Field Notebook.

[ON SCREEN: Confetti]

[ON SCREEN: Bonus tool]
Want more? Try the radar gun at the very end.

[ON SCREEN: Next time]
Next time, a fair test at Dune Hill. Press Listen for Sam’s last word.

quiz.label: Self-Check
quiz.script: Quick check: three questions, one at a time. It’s not graded. If you miss one, read the hint and try again.
